name: As of Stage Number
description: Latest selected stage; no selection means stage 21.

name: Snapshot Label
expression: "STANDINGS AFTER STAGE " & FORMAT([As of Stage Number], "00")

name: Eligible Riders
expression: VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(SUM('Standing'[Eligible]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s)

name: Exited Riders
expression: VAR s=[As of Stage Number] RETURN COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER('Rider',NOT ISBLANK('Rider'[Exit Stage]) && 'Rider'[Exit Stage]<=s)),0)
description: Explicit withdrawals by the selected stage; incomplete results alone are not an exit.

name: Eligible Cumulative Hours
expression: VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(SUM('Standing'[Cumulative Seconds]), 'Standing'[Eligible] = 1),3600), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s)
description: Sum of eligible riders cumulative adjusted time in the selected rider/team slice.

name: Rider Cumulative Seconds
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Rider'[Bib]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(CALCULATE(MAX('Standing'[Cumulative Seconds]), 'Standing'[Eligible]=1), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s))

name: Rider Cumulative Time
expression: VAR t=[Rider Cumulative Seconds] RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(t), FORMAT(INT(t/3600),"0") & ":" & FORMAT(INT(MOD(t,3600)/60),"00") & ":" & FORMAT(MOD(t,60),"00"))

name: GC Rank
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Rider'[Bib]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Standing'[GC Rank]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s))
description: Global competition rank. Preserved under rider/team filtering; blank when ineligible.

name: Points Rank
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Rider'[Bib]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Standing'[Points Rank]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s))
description: Global competition rank. Preserved under rider/team filtering; blank when ineligible.

name: KOM Rank
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Rider'[Bib]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Standing'[KOM Rank]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s))
description: Global competition rank. Preserved under rider/team filtering; blank when ineligible.

name: Young Rank
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Rider'[Bib]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Standing'[Young Rank]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s))
description: Global competition rank. Preserved under rider/team filtering; blank when ineligible.

name: Cumulative Points
expression: VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(CALCULATE(SUM('Standing'[Points]), 'Standing'[Eligible]=1), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s)

name: Cumulative KOM Points
expression: VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(CALCULATE(SUM('Standing'[KOM Points]), 'Standing'[Eligible]=1), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s)

name: Rider Status
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Rider'[Bib]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(SELECTEDVALUE('Standing'[Status]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s))

name: GC Gap Seconds
expression: VAR t=[Rider Cumulative Seconds] VAR s=[As of Stage Number] VAR leader=CALCULATE(MIN('Standing'[Cumulative Seconds]),REMOVEFILTERS('Rider'),REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'),'Standing'[Stage]=s,'Standing'[Eligible]=1) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(t),t-leader)
description: Gap to global GC leader, seconds.

name: Classification Rider Hours
expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Classification'[Classification]),"General",[Eligible Cumulative Hours],"Young Rider",CALCULATE([Eligible Cumulative Hours],'Rider'[Young Rider]=1))
description: The same eligible field participates in General, Points and Mountains; time is not their points score.

name: Running Rider Hours
description: All stage types through the x-axis stage; includes historical completed effort before exits.

name: Best Team Rank
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Team'[Team]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Team Standing'[Team Rank]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Team Standing'[Stage] = s))
description: Rank by stages scored DESC, then cumulative stage top-3 time ASC.

name: Team Cumulative Hours
expression: VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('Team Standing'[Cumulative Top3 Seconds]),3600), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Team Standing'[Stage] = s)

name: Stages Scored
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Team'[Team]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Team Standing'[Stages Scored]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Team Standing'[Stage] = s))

name: Team Coverage
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Team'[Team]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(SELECTEDVALUE('Team Standing'[Coverage]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Team Standing'[Stage] = s))

name: Teams by Country
description: Country dimension intentionally applies team nationality independently.

name: Riders by Country
description: Registered rider nationality, independent of team nationality; includes exited riders.

name: Roster Riders
description: Intersection of selected country and roster hierarchy; blank hides unrelated roster branches.

name: Stage Winner Gap Seconds
expression: AVERAGEX('Result', VAR s='Result'[Stage] VAR winner=CALCULATE(MIN('Result'[Adjusted Seconds]),REMOVEFILTERS('Rider'),REMOVEFILTERS('Result'),'Result'[Stage]=s,'Result'[Position]=1) RETURN 'Result'[Adjusted Seconds]-winner)
description: Mean adjusted-time gap to the rider placed first; can be negative after adjustments.

name: Speed Proxy kmh
description: Distance / raw finish hours. Teams use summed rider-distance / summed rider-time, not summed speeds.

name: Mountain Cumulative Seconds
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Rider'[Bib]) && NOT ISBLANK([GC Rank]), VAR s=[As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(SUM('Result'[Adjusted Seconds]),FILTER(ALL('Stage'),'Stage'[Stage]<=s && 'Stage'[Stage Type]="Mountain")))

name: Mountain GC Proxy Rank
expression: VAR t=[Mountain Cumulative Seconds] VAR field=FILTER(ALL('Rider'),NOT ISBLANK(CALCULATE([Mountain Cumulative Seconds]))) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(t),RANKX(field,[Mountain Cumulative Seconds],t,ASC,Skip))
description: Time-only mountain proxy, distinct from KOM points.

name: Young GC at Race Start Rank
expression: VAR t=[Rider Cumulative Seconds] VAR age=SELECTEDVALUE('Rider'[Age at Race Start]) VAR field=FILTER(ALL('Rider'),'Rider'[Age at Race Start]<26 && NOT ISBLANK(CALCULATE([Rider Cumulative Seconds]))) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(t) && age<26,RANKX(field,[Rider Cumulative Seconds],t,ASC,Skip))
description: Under 26 on the first stage date; separate from the original calendar-year Young Rider rule.

name: GC Rank Change
expression: VAR s=SELECTEDVALUE('Stage'[Stage]) VAR nowRank=[GC Trace Rank] VAR prior=CALCULATE(MAX('Standing'[GC Rank]),REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'),'Standing'[Stage]=s-1) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(nowRank) && NOT ISBLANK(prior),prior-nowRank)
description: Positive = places gained; blank on first stage or after exit.

name: Top Ten Position
expression: VAR pos=[Stage Position] RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(pos) && pos<=10,pos)

name: Cumulative Bonus Seconds
expression: VAR s=[As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE([Bonus Seconds],FILTER(ALL('Stage'),'Stage'[Stage]<=s))

name: Cumulative Penalty Seconds
expression: VAR s=[As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE([Penalty Seconds],FILTER(ALL('Stage'),'Stage'[Stage]<=s))

name: Scenario Seconds
expression: VAR t=[Rider Cumulative Seconds] VAR mode=SELECTEDVALUE('Scenario'[Scenario],"Official adjusted") RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(t),t+IF(mode IN {"No bonuses","No bonuses or penalties"},[Cumulative Bonus Seconds],0)-IF(mode IN {"No penalties","No bonuses or penalties"},[Cumulative Penalty Seconds],0))

name: Scenario GC Rank
expression: VAR t=[Scenario Seconds] VAR field=FILTER(ALL('Rider'),NOT ISBLANK(CALCULATE([Scenario Seconds]))) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(t),RANKX(field,[Scenario Seconds],t,ASC,Skip))

name: Scenario Rank Change
expression: IF(NOT ISBLANK([GC Rank]),[GC Rank]-[Scenario GC Rank])

name: Top Ten Movement
expression: VAR a=[GC Rank] VAR b=[Scenario GC Rank] RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(a),SWITCH(TRUE(),a>10 && b<=10,"Entered top 10",a<=10 && b>10,"Left top 10",a<=10,"Stayed top 10","Outside top 10"))

name: Country Best GC Rank
expression: VAR s=[As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(MIN('Standing'[GC Rank]),REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'),'Standing'[Stage]=s,KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(VALUES('Country'[Country]),'Rider'[Rider Country])))

name: Country Rider Hours
description: Completed effort from riders representing the selected country; includes effort before exit.

name: Scenario Stage Adjustment Seconds
expression: VAR s=[As of Stage Number] VAR mode=SELECTEDVALUE('Scenario'[Scenario],"Official adjusted") VAR bibs=CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('Standing'[Bib]),REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'),'Standing'[Stage]=s,'Standing'[Eligible]=1) VAR bonus=CALCULATE([Bonus Seconds],KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(bibs,'Rider'[Bib])),KEEPFILTERS('Stage'[Stage]<=s)) VAR penalty=CALCULATE([Penalty Seconds],KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(bibs,'Rider'[Bib])),KEEPFILTERS('Stage'[Stage]<=s)) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(bonus)||NOT ISBLANK(penalty),IF(mode IN {"Official adjusted","No bonuses"},penalty,0)-IF(mode IN {"Official adjusted","No penalties"},bonus,0))
description: Net seconds applied to raw finish time under the selected rules, for riders eligible at the snapshot.

name: Roster Bib
description: Bib of a rider in the intersection of the selected team and country.

name: Award leaders
expression: VAR c=SELECTEDVALUE('Classification'[Classification]) VAR leaders=CALCULATETABLE(FILTER(ALL('Rider'),[Classification Rank]=1),REMOVEFILTERS('Rider'),REMOVEFILTERS('Stage')) VAR score=MAXX(leaders,SWITCH(c,"Points",[Cumulative Points],"Mountains",[Cumulative KOM Points],[Rider Cumulative Seconds])) RETURN IF(c IN {"Points","Mountains"},LOOKUPVALUE('Jersey Leaders'[Leader],'Jersey Leaders'[Stage],[As of Stage Number],'Jersey Leaders'[Classification],c),IF(NOT ISBLANK(score),CONCATENATEX(leaders,'Rider'[Rider],", ",'Rider'[Bib],ASC)))
description: Full-field leaders through the selected stage. Points and Mountains use published first-place snapshots including official tie-breaks.

name: Winning score
expression: VAR c=SELECTEDVALUE('Classification'[Classification]) VAR leaders=CALCULATETABLE(FILTER(ALL('Rider'),[Classification Rank]=1),REMOVEFILTERS('Rider'),REMOVEFILTERS('Stage')) VAR exportedScore=MAXX(leaders,SWITCH(c,"Points",[Cumulative Points],"Mountains",[Cumulative KOM Points],[Rider Cumulative Seconds])) VAR score=IF(c IN {"Points","Mountains"},LOOKUPVALUE('Jersey Leaders'[Points],'Jersey Leaders'[Stage],[As of Stage Number],'Jersey Leaders'[Classification],c),exportedScore) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(score),IF(c IN {"Points","Mountains"},FORMAT(score,"0") & " pts",FORMAT(INT(score/3600),"0") & ":" & FORMAT(INT(MOD(score,3600)/60),"00") & ":" & FORMAT(MOD(score,60),"00")))

name: Winning rule
expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Classification'[Classification]),"General","Lowest total adjusted time","Points","Highest sprint/finish points; official tie-breaks","Mountains","Highest climb-points total; official tie-breaks","Young Rider","Lowest total adjusted time; born on or after 1 Jan 2000")

name: Team deficit minutes
expression: VAR scored=[Stages Scored] VAR most=MAXX(ALL('Team'),[Stages Scored]) VAR referenceTime=MINX(FILTER(ALL('Team'),[Stages Scored]=most),[Team Cumulative Hours]) RETURN IF(HASONEVALUE('Team'[Team]) && scored=most,ROUND(60*([Team Cumulative Hours]-referenceTime),2))
description: Time behind the leading team; only teams with the same scored-stage coverage are comparable.

name: GC daily deficit seconds
expression: VAR t=IF(HASONEVALUE('Stage'[Stage]) && HASONEVALUE('Rider'[Bib]),CALCULATE(MIN('Standing'[Cumulative Seconds]),'Standing'[Eligible]=1)) VAR bestTime=CALCULATE(MIN('Standing'[Cumulative Seconds]),REMOVEFILTERS('Rider'),'Standing'[Eligible]=1) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(t),t-bestTime)
description: Gap to the overall leader on the axis stage; zero is a shared or outright lead.

name: Mountain podium finishes
description: Mountain-stage top-three finishes; only podium finishers are shown.

name: Top Ten Finish Gap
expression: VAR pos=[Top Ten Position] VAR winner=CALCULATE(MIN('Result'[Finish Seconds]),REMOVEFILTERS('Rider'),'Result'[Position]=1) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(pos),MAX('Result'[Finish Seconds])-winner)
description: Raw finish seconds behind the stage winner; tied finish times may have different positions.

name: Exit count
description: Recorded exits, attributed to the stage not completed; DNS is distinct from mid-stage withdrawal.

name: Field remaining
expression: VAR s=SELECTEDVALUE('Stage'[Stage]) VAR started=CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Rider'),REMOVEFILTERS('Rider')) VAR departed=CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Withdrawal'),REMOVEFILTERS('Withdrawal'),REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'),REMOVEFILTERS('Rider'),'Withdrawal'[Stage]<=s) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(s),started-COALESCE(departed,0))
description: Whole registered field less all exits through this stage.

name: Mapped riders
description: Unknown nationality is retained in the roster, not geocoded.

name: Mean top-ten finish gap
description: Mean raw time gap across stages where this rider placed in the top ten.
